A new community app for people living with chronic illness.

Find connection. Find support. Find your rhythm.

Healing is easier when we do it together. RootdCore is a community app made for people living with chronic illness. Check in with yourself, share what's helping, discover practitioners and recipes, and connect with people who understand.
